# The Feishu UI for DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
English | 中文
The Feishu UI for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — a dsh-native plugin with a **panel-driven control console
**: every slash command is a button on the ⚙️ control-panel card, approvals and questions resolve in
side the chat, and one QR scan sets the whole app up.

> **Note:** DeepSeek Harness is
> still pre-release and may break between releases. This package is

the
> **DSH `0.2.1-rc.5` port** of PGZXB/dsh-feishu
> (MIT): the upstream implementation is kept as-

is in `lib/` and patched where
> the 0.2.1 host API changed. Host packages (`@deepseek-ai/*`, `cordi

s`) are
> `peerDependencies` — the DSH runtime supplies them.
### Host services and bundle scope

The bundle patch inserts **only the `feishu` row**. It deliberately does not
re-insert `schedule` or

`tool-ask-user`: DSH 0.2.1 already mounts them
(`dsh-web-app` and the agent presets), and `dsh-app-

boot` appends `insert`
entries without dedupe — a duplicate service provider or tool name would fail

the boot. To customize schedule config, use an id-targeted override (see the
comments in `cordis.pa

To customize schedule config, use an id-targeted override (see the
comments in `cordis.patch.yml`).

The plugin declares a minimal `inject` list — `agents`, `sessionQuery`,
`commands`, `tools` — so cor

dis waits for the services the chat surface cannot
work without. Everything else is an optional capa

bility read through
`ctx.get(...)` and degraded with a warning: `approval`, `userQuestions`,
`attach

ments`, `workspaceRegistry`, `sessionTitle`, `permissionPresets`,
`planMode`, `agentDefaultModel`, `

agentPresets`, `llm`, `schedule`,
`credentials`.

## Usage

A Feishu chat is a dsh session — the bot is the agent's avatar. A typical
session goes like this:

1. **Start a chat.** Direct-message the bot, or run `/group <name>` to
create a group the bot joins.

In a group, @-mention the bot (the
default policy; a group with just you and the bot also answers p

lain
messages, and the policy is configurable).
2. **Open the control panel.** Send `panel` or `/panel` to open the card-based console.

3. **Pick a working directory.** Before the first turn, the bot opens the
workspace picker automatic

ally. The panel also offers **🗂️ Workspaces**
with recent, favorite, searchable, and custom-path cho

The panel also offers **🗂️ Workspaces**
with recent, favorite, searchable, and custom-path choices.

4. **Ask.** Send a message — the agent runs and its output streams into a
live card (tool calls, rea

soning, markdown, tables). The card ends green
with the full answer inside; Stop, copy, retry, and t

he ⚙️ panel button
sit on it.
| Mid-stream | Finalized |

5. **Approve or answer when asked.** A permission escalation posts an
approval card — tap **Allow on

ce** (or **Reject**). A question posts a
card you answer with a tap (or a reply).
| Approval | Question |

6. **Manage workspaces, sessions, and Agent modes.** **🗂️ Workspaces** lists the same
registered nam

es as DSH Desktop and can switch, add, search, favorite,
rename, or safely remove a registration wit

hout deleting files or history.
**🗂️ Sessions** filters by all sessions, current workspace, or this

Feishu
chat, then lets you inspect, resume, rename, fork, archive, or export.
**🧠 Agent mode** switc

hes between standard, Codex, Claude Code, and custom
presets by preserving the current session and o

pening a safe new one.
**➕ New chat** starts fresh without deleting the old session.

Every button on the panel card maps to a slash command — pick whichever
feels faster; `/help` lists

ton on the panel card maps to a slash command — pick whichever
feels faster; `/help` lists them all.
## Commands
| Command | What it does |

| `/help` | list all commands |
| `/panel` | open the control-panel card (all commands as buttons) |

| `/group <name>` | create a group with the bot (bare opens a name-input card) |
| `/cancel` | stop

the running turn |
| `/cd <path>` | set this chat's working directory (bare opens a path-input card

) |
| `/repo [path]` | pick a project directory (bare scans the default roots; `/repo <path>` scans

that path) |
[该节后续省略]
## Features
- **Live streaming cards** — tool calls, reasoning, markdown, and tables stream in as the agent work

s.
- **One-tap control panel** — `/panel` renders the full command palette as buttons; no command sy

ntax to remember, and each button is the exact equivalent of typing the command.
- **Card-based work
spaces and sessions** — add, switch, search, favorite, rename, and safely remove registered workspac

es; filter, resume, rename, fork, archive, and export sessions by all/workspace/chat scope.
- **Agen
t mode management** — choose standard, Codex, Claude Code, or a custom preset without mixing incompa

tible tool histories into the old session.
- **Native image and file input** — images enter DSH's na
tive vision attachment path; files retain both a durable DSH reference and a workspace-readable path

, with safe fallback when attachment storage is unavailable.
- **In-card approvals & questions** — a

pprove a permission escalation or answer the agent's questions in the chat.
- **Sessions survive res

tarts** — a chat's session (and its working directory) is persisted across daemon restarts.
- **Grou

ps & mentions** — @-mention the bot; error notices, approvals, and questions @ the requester.
- **Re
actions, allowlists, reminders, export, diagnostics** — reaction ack, `allowedChats` / `allowedUsers
`, scheduled reminders, session-log files, and a status card.
